title: Page 156
transc:
Gates Columbus O.  Wash. Aug. 18. 1864
Pagan Nancy Aug 18th for bologna
---- In case of necessity you
will call on Gen Bur bridge
to assist you ---- It is
impossible at the present time to
send you more youth from here
Gov. Brough can raise some Stanhopes
from the discharged hundred days men
in a few days Sig Applause


5pm
Beckwith City Pt No 2  Wash. Aug 20. 1864
Huron laura Oliver Belly There is in
Lou don County a considerable Settlement of
Quakers Saginaw tooth whisky but never disturbed
nor con - Scripted by the violets tulip
No doubt they would be very willing
to have their produce & animals impressed
but ought they not toby personally excepted 
Savory late repeat to Negus Stanhope pollux
